notes: All included third-party clips were obtained from the official author or asset page without payment.
No clip file was edited; bank gain, playback loop, and pitch settings are game-side settings.
The Kenney Voiceover Pack: Fighter and OpenGameArt Water Waves FLACs are not shipped or used because they do not suit the named creature casts or current Godot audio path.

Eight loopable music tracks by MintoDog were downloaded directly from their OpenGameArt pages under CC0 1.0; the two tracks already present in the Cage Rules project were hash-verified against those official downloads. Files are unedited; loop and gain are configured in-game.
